versions.changelog:
Initial release of exam-paper-error-analysis skill with support for comprehensive error analysis across general and vocational education.

- Provides four main capabilities: single-question deep analysis, entire paper loss analysis, variant question generation, and error-type guided review.
- Supports both text and file input (images, PDFs), with PDF-to-image conversion using pypdfium2 and built-in multimodal recognition (no external/local OCR).
- Covers K12 and vocational fields (8+ professions) including mechanical, IT, accounting, nursing, automotive, architecture, tourism, e-commerce, etc.
- Includes strict input validation, robust handling of file quality, and clear user-guided input completion.
- Enforces evidence-based, actionable analysis principles while prohibiting generic or unsupported conclusions.
- Analysis is tailored by subject and complexity, with special enhancements for vocational education (job standards mapping, operation/safety focus).
- All results are integrated into structured HTML reports using provided templates.
